arguments.summary: Host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) was compromised and used to conduct lateral movement attempts within the network. The host exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior to external C2 infrastructure (198.51.100.23) and attempted Kerberos pre-authentication attacks against internal systems. A suspicious authentication sequence involving user j.martinez was traced back to this host due to IP misattribution in initial alert. Immediate containment actions include network isolation of the host and revocation of associated user credentials (jsmith). No evidence of data exfiltration or ransomware deployment was found during analysis.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos Pre-Auth from Non-DC Host
logsource:
    category: authentication
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    event_id: 4771
    src_host: '*'
    dest_host: '*'
    # Exclude domain controllers
    - not:
        src_host: '*DC*'
    - not:
        src_ip: '10.0.8.*'
condition: event_id and not 1 of exclude_*
level: high
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate account lockouts from service accounts
    - Misconfigured clients
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1212/
author: SOC Team
